scope: Production semantic display disposal and viewport replacement/teardown recovery
behavior: Retiring display is hidden immediately; detach/geometry/material disposal phases are all attempted.
Successful phases are not repeated; failed phases remain retryable and reentrant disposal is guarded.
Viewport retains failed display retirements, including unpublished replacement cleanup, until retry succeeds.
Later scene updates drain pending retirements and recreate displays rather than reuse retired objects.
Reference cleanup failures do not stop remaining viewport teardown; later disposal retries retained resources.
